lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming approximately five horizontal tiers along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, most prominent in the mid-lateral section behind the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges characterized by a sharp vertical gradient, showing high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-intensity blobs distributed across the visible lateral face of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
